ValidationRule.description: Ensures that an agent has filled out all fields prior to closing case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), (RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed"), OR( ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_Defects_Rectified__c, "" ), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_ID_True_Document__c, ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_ID_Not_Picture__c , ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_Customer_Photo_Modified__c , ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_Security_Features__c , ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_ID_Legible__c , "Yes"), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_Customer_Details__c , ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_EV_Match__c, ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_EV_Consent__c, ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_EV_Rules_Met__c, ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_PO_Box__c , ""), ISPICKVAL (KYCQA_Middle_Name__c , "")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are attempting to close this KYC QA case however have not answered all checks. Please ensure all checks are completed prior to case closure.
